description: This file contains utility functions for Triton JIT-compiled kernels used in sparse block and index handling, including functions for calculating block offsets, clamping indices, and loading data with boundary checks.

methods.name: get_offset_for_next_block
methods.description: Calculates the memory offset for the next block in a sparse block tensor, considering whether blocks are contiguous.

methods.name: get_bounded_indices
methods.description: Clamps indices within a maximum length if provided.

methods.name: load_checked_block
methods.description: Loads a block with boundary checking based on divisibility and safety flags.

methods.name: load_checked_2d
methods.description: Loads a 2D block of data with boundary checks and optional stride adjustments.
